remarks: One floor living just minutes from downtown New Canaan! Located close to the Merritt Parkway, shopping, restaurants and train. This two bedroom unit is on the first floor of a two-family home and includes 2 off-street driveway parking spaces. Ample storage, newer full bathroom with tub, updated kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances including a professional-grade gas stove, dishwasher, refrigerator and washer/dryer. Hardwood floors throughout living room, dine-in kitchen and bedrooms. Primary bedroom includes large walk-in closet and second bedroom makes a perfect office or second bedroom. Level, shared fully fenced-in backyard in addition to private terrace off of kitchen. This rental has it all and pets are welcome! Tenant responsible for credit check, application, rental insurance, all utilities including heat (propane), electricity, cable/internet. 1st months rent and 2 months security (one month if 62 or older) at signing of lease. Landlord reserves the right to meet potential tenant/s. Good credit a must.
